headline: Chile's Agrosuper Negotiates $540 Million Salmon Acquisition
summary: Chilean food producer Agrosuper is in non-binding negotiations to acquire Blumar's salmon business for up to US$540 million.
why: This potential M&A deal would significantly consolidate the Chilean salmon industry, a major export sector for the country.
